precondition: No genuine V6.8 human pilot has occurred; every prepared or adversarial root remains ineligible for repaired qualification.
objective: Close independently demonstrated pre-pilot trust defects without adding product capability, UI work, architecture, or V7 scope.

critical: Terminal validation must re-derive faithfulness, replay, mission status, measurements, and coverage from each immutable live mission root and require byte agreement with its package.
A SUPPORTED report sentence must be content-bound to its cited observational record; reference resolution alone is insufficient.
high: V6.7 residual identities, outcome kinds, collection bounds, clean reconstruction, and kernel identity must be rechecked from the terminal report.
Coverage must use exact frozen labels and real passing-mission activity; preparation-only state and lossy aliases cannot establish coverage.
Frozen starting-state descriptions must match prepared state and M2 must contain no preparation-authored conclusion.
The Croatian derivative must retain explicit dependence on English v1 and cannot support current N-4 after v2 correction.
Pilot sessions must be ordered closed intervals and counted work must occur within the matching interval.
M3 must scan raw public-marked records for full and truncated restricted identifiers and its public-check actor must be read-only.
additional: The pilot protocol is frozen by hash.
All three mission dispositions require a genuine distinct-approver signature.
Replay must execute under an enforced denied-network context rather than assert offline operation.
Measurements identify successful in-session retrievals as interaction proxies, not proof of cognition.
Every present custody copy must hash correctly.
Preparation records executable and kernel identity and refuses a dirty executable checkout.
The focused suite locks the accepted adversarial mutations without an invented numeric pass floor.
Pilot logs redact record identifiers while retaining salted-free SHA-256 identity for measurement.

forbidden_repairs: weaken or waive any V6.7 invariant
trust packaged status or coverage as authority
claim machine proof of physical human presence
change the existing UI or add a product plane
implement a Maven-class or V7 capability
reuse a campaign prepared by the reviewed executable for terminal qualification
acceptance: The full forged-package campaign returns NOT_ACHIEVED.
The unrelated green-cheese SUPPORTED sentence fails faithfulness.
Forged V6.7 residual or kernel identity fails terminal validation.
Reverse or unbounded sessions fail and their actions are excluded from measurements.
M2 current-state validation rejects dependent N-4 support.
M3 full and truncated restricted identifiers are detected and public mutation is refused.
All original focused protections and affected V6.7 gates remain green under accepted residual methodology.
escalation: If a repair requires a product architecture change, UI redesign, V6.7 weakening, or V7 capability, retain NOT_ACHIEVED and stop before the human pilot.
